queries_run: Farm & Heavy Construction Machinery price trend 2026 used equipment prices
Caterpillar channel inventory level 2026 dealer inventories third quarter

findings.claim: CAT 經銷商庫存 2026 上半年回補 $26 億（去年同期增 $2 億），其中 Construction Industries 增 $19 億（去年同期減 $4 億）
findings.excerpt: Dealer inventory increased $2.6 billion during the six months ended June 30, 2026, compared with an increase of $200 million during the six months ended June 30, 2025.

findings.claim: Q1 2026 經銷商庫存增 $20 億（去年同期增 $1 億），Construction Industries 增 $15 億
findings.excerpt: Total dealer inventory increased $2.0 billion during the first quarter of 2026, compared with an increase of $100 million during the first quarter of 2025.

findings.claim: 二手營建設備價值因庫存上升而下滑；農機市場處於長期下行但價格仍維持高檔（次級來源摘要）
findings.source: equipmentfinancenews.com 'Used construction equipment values fall amid rising inventories'

findings.claim: 管理層預期 Q4 Construction Industries 經銷商庫存下降逾 $10 億
findings.source: Insider Monkey 'Caterpillar (CAT): Can Earnings Keep Growing After Dealers Stop Restocking?'
findings.excerpt: Management expects Construction Industries dealer inventories to decline by more than $1 billion in the fourth quarter. Dealers can satisfy customers by selling machines already on hand, reducing factory shipments even when retail activity remains healthy.

cyclical_inventory_price_position.note: Q4 經銷商去化（管理層預期 CI 經銷商庫存降逾 $10 億）僅見次級來源轉述（Insider Monkey），未取得原文；Q3 2026 經銷商庫存變動數字未查到。無單一權威現貨/合約價指數。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
